clips.title: The story
paras: At Agamand Mills, the Agamand Family Mace remains locked in the family crypt. Once a proud heirloom of northern Lordaeron, it is now sought by their former servant, Coleman Farthing.

Before the Third War, the Agamand family held vast farmlands and windmills in northern Tirisfal Glades. Like the region’s other aristocrats, they fell to the plague of undeath. The Scourge raised them as mindless thralls in service to the Lich King, and they wander their ruined estate. Their ancient treasures remain locked in the family crypt. Among them rests the Agamand Family Mace, a remnant of a lineage reduced to shambling undead.
